usage: After operator review, save as literal_search.py. Run with Python 3.9+: python3 literal_search.py < input.json. Input example: {"root":"/approved/project","query":"item-example","path":"."}. Alternatively import search and pass that dictionary. The operator must approve root; the tool cannot establish approval itself. Searches recursively, including hidden files, using case-sensitive literal matching within each line. Returns one record per matching line, sorted by root-relative POSIX path and 1-based line number; text excludes line endings. No matches returns {"matches":[]}. Paths resolving outside root, including ../, invalid inputs, missing paths and filesystem errors return {"error":"invalid_input"}. Non-UTF-8 files and symlinks encountered during traversal are skipped. An explicitly selected symlink is resolved and accepted only within root. Assumes the filesystem is not concurrently modified by an adversary. Reads whole files into memory. Source has not been executed or tested against the supplied fixture paths.
